question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.**

He planned a weeklong ______ down the Nile.
solution:
The correct answer is **"cruise."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A homonym is a word that is said or spelled the same way as another word but has a different meaning.
 
• **"Write”** and **“right”** is a good example of a pair of homonym.
 
• **"Cruise"** means a voyage on a ship or boat taken for pleasure or as a holiday and is the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank in the given sentence. (समुद्र मार्ग द्वारा विभिन्न स्थानों का पर्यटन करना; समुद्री पर्यटन, समुद्र-विहार)
 
• The word is a noun and can also be used as a verb.
 
• In this context, it is used as a noun.
 
 
• **Example**: *They’re planning to go on a **cruise**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

**Correct sentence**: *He planned a weeklong __**cruise**__** down the Nile. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 - Crews**: This is a plural noun referring to a group of people working together, especially on a ship or aircraft. (जहाज़, विमान आदि के सभी कर्मचारी)
 
• **Option 2 - Cruse**: This is a noun that means a small container for holding liquid, typically oil or wine. (तरल पदार्थ, आमतौर पर तेल या वाइन रखने के लिए एक छोटा कंटेनर)
 
• **Option 3 - crus**: This is a noun that refers to any of the military expeditions undertaken by European Christians in the 11th-13th centuries to recover the Holy Land from the Muslims. (मुसलमानों से पवित्र भूमि को पुनः प्राप्त करने के लिए 11वीं-13वीं शताब्दी में यूरोपीय ईसाइयों द्वारा किए गए सैन्य अभियानों में से कोई भी)
